title: DiscoverVerifyResponse
description: Verified org choices and sign-in options for an email.

emailTx.description: Short-lived handle proving email ownership. Use with passkey/password endpoints to obtain loginTx, then exchange at /auth/token.

emailTxExpiresAt.description: UTC timestamp when the emailTx expires (hint for clients).

localConnections.description: User-level, org-independent local auth methods available for this email.

memberships.description: Organizations this email can access or has pending invitations for.

status.description: Active membership allows sign-in; invited requires accepting an invitation.

connections.description: Org-scoped SSO sign-in options (OIDC/SAML). May be empty when the org has no SSO configured.

policy.description: Per-org sign-in policy preview for discovery.

requiresSso.description: If true, local login (passkey/password) must NOT be used to access this org; SSO is mandatory.

note.description: Optional hint for the user (e.g., 'Use your invitation link to join').
